svg.title: One moment, many reactions — execution at step 30, 0 ms
svg.desc: A fixed pipeline graph and four synchronized lanes: time, source notifications, internal reactions, and resulting notifications. Dashed glyphs identify modelled explanations; solid glyphs identify observed events. Events at one time retain their sequence order. Subscription endings distinguish completion from cancellation.

g.aria-label: Inspect of(1, 2, 3, 4, 5). A synchronous cold source. Early teardown stops production after 3.. unsubscribe · cancelled. Values enter here
g.title: of(1, 2, 3, 4, 5): A synchronous cold source. Early teardown stops production after 3.

g.aria-label: Inspect filter(isOdd). The named domain predicate accepts odd numbers.. unsubscribe · cancelled. input=3 · accepted=true
g.title: filter(isOdd): The named domain predicate accepts odd numbers.

g.aria-label: Inspect map(timesTen). A synchronous value transformation, with no queue or separate worker.. unsubscribe · cancelled. Reacts to notifications
g.title: map(timesTen): A synchronous value transformation, with no queue or separate worker.

g.aria-label: Inspect take(2). Complete after two accepted values and tear down upstream.. unsubscribe · complete. accepted=2 · limit=2
g.title: take(2): Complete after two accepted values and tear down upstream.

g.aria-label: Inspect Observer. Receives 10, 30, Complete, all at time 0. Sequence numbers preserve their ordering.. unsubscribe · complete. Subscriber receives
g.title: Observer: Receives 10, 30, Complete, all at time 0. Sequence numbers preserve their ordering.
